rules.title: ES modules
rules.text: Use ES modules and the node: prefix for built-in imports.

rules.title: async/await
rules.text: Use async/await and always handle promise rejections.

rules.title: Central config
rules.text: Read environment variables in one config module and validate them at startup.

rules.title: Graceful shutdown
rules.text: Handle SIGTERM and close servers and connections gracefully.

rules.title: No blocking calls
rules.text: Do not use synchronous filesystem or crypto calls in request handlers.
